# Demo: package_name

This Quarto notebook demonstrates loading the `package_name` package and using its helper functions.

```{r}
# Load the package module using box (path is relative to project root)
# [...] imports all functions from the module into the hello object
box::use(./src/package_name/hello[...])
```
```{r}
# Use the greeting helpers via the module object
say_hello("Alice")
```
